اعتطفن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَطَفْنَ (iʕtaṭafna) /iʕ.ta.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اُعْتُطِفْنَ (uʕtuṭifna) /uʕ.tu.tˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# اِعْتَطِفْنَ (iʕtaṭifna) /iʕ.ta.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
